m: पिस् cl. 4. P. (Naigh. ii, 14) पिस्यति (pf. 3. pl. पिपिसुः), to stretch, expand, ŚBr.; cl. 1. पेसति, to go, move, Dhātup. xvii, 69; cl. 10. पेसयति id.; to hurt; to be strong; to give or to take; to dwell, xxxii, 32 (cf. पिष्, Caus.)
a: पिस् — {vI.v} {c1c} P. (पेसति) To go, move. {vII.v} {c10c} U. (पेसयति-ते) 1 To go. --2 To be strong. --3 To dwell. --4 To hurt, injure. --5 To give or take.
